pages.title: Fermenter
pages.text: A sealed vat of warm sugar water with a culture working in it, an airlock bubbling on top.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the sugar level and the air. Growth follows S/(Ks + S) but too much sugar inhibits it (Haldane): it must reach 80% of its best. Growing yeast needs air; fermenting needs none.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Ammonia, Bacterial Culture, Magnetite, Methane, Nucleotide, Nutrient Broth, Probiotic Seal, Yeast Culture.
